hints.title: Line Projection Invariants
hints.text: A lamp at cell r, c illuminates all cells sharing row r, column c, primary diagonal r - c, and secondary diagonal r + c. Use frequency counts for these four projections.

hints.title: Deduplicated Active Lamps
hints.text: Input lamps may contain duplicate coordinates. Maintain unique active lamp positions in a coordinate container to prevent multiple increments from the exact same lamp.

hints.title: Neighbor Extinguishment
hints.text: For each query, answer 1 if any of the 4 projections has count > 0, else 0. Then examine all 9 neighboring cells around the query: if a lamp exists there, remove it and decrement the 4 projection tallies.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining an explicit N x N grid times out and exceeds memory limits when N is up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing frequency counts for active lines in projection dictionaries scales linearly with lamp and query counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that N is up to 10^9, map line coordinates using row, col, r-c, r+c, and turn off adjacent lamps.
complexity.notes: Checking 9 neighboring cells per query is O(1) per query.
